product_metadata.title: Let's Make Memories Special Family Member Christmas Ornament - First Christmas As Family Oval Ornament - Ornament for New Grandparents or New Parents - Christmas 2022 Keepsake Ornament
features: TOGETHER FOR THE HOLIDAYS: There's nothing more magical than your first Christmas together as a family. Celebrate this amazing milestone with a personalized ornament that will remind you of this joyous time for years to come.
UNIQUELY PERSONALIZED: Customize your ornament with any name up to 12 characters, any title up to 22 characters and the year. Includes white ribbon for hanging.

A FESTIVE FIRST CHRISTMAS: This sweet and sentimental keepsake ornament features the words "First Christmas as" and is decorated with their names, titles and a sweet accent of candy canes and Christmas trees.
PREMIUM QUALITY: Made in the USA, this beautifully crafted 3.25" 3.5"Hx5.25"W personalized ornament is made of wood and customized to help them celebrate their love of family for many years to come.
A MEMORABLE GIFT: They'll never forget their first Christmas as a family. Give them a gift that will remind them of this special time as they hang it on their tree every year.
